caption: Brendan Ngwa Nforbi v. Hertz Global Holdings, Inc.
claims: No complaint filed. Record held for a prospective Penal Code section 290.46(j) claim. The November 2, 2026 notice is preliminary.
status: November 2, 2026: HireRight completed the background report on the accepted Manager Trainee offer. The Hertz Corporation sent a preliminary pre-adverse letter the same day. The letter specifies alcohol-related information and does not mention a registry. The decision is not final, and the deadline line is unfilled. Element map: PC29046_EVIDENCE.md.
defendants: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. (requested caption; ADP WOTC entity). The Hertz Corporation (offer and the November 2, 2026 pre-adverse letter). HireRight, LLC (consumer reporting agency named on the letter and the report). No complaint is filed.
note: Not a filed case. November 2 report is in the file. Registry subrequests split by name form, and the report says the search ran through the U.S. Department of Justice while researcher notes cite Penal Code section 290.46. The pre-adverse letter specifies alcohol-related information only. Do not treat a product list, an In Registry line, or this preliminary letter as proof of website use or of a completed denial. Map: PC29046_EVIDENCE.md.
key_facts: October 22: The Hertz Corporation offered, and the applicant accepted, full-time Manager Trainee work in Palo Alto at $23 an hour, requisition 43711. October 23: HireRight disclosures were completed for order OR-102326-NH87V, including a National Sex Offender Registry product on the disclosure list. November 2, 2026, 2:29 a.m. Pacific: HireRight completed the report for Kesha Nedio-Casey, Hertz pre-employment, adjudication Client Review Required. Registry results split by name: In Registry on Newanforbi forms, Not in Registry on Brendan Ngwa. Researcher notes cite Penal Code section 290.46 and say the search was performed through the U.S. Department of Justice. The report does not say the hit came from the Megan's Law website. The same day Hertz sent a preliminary pre-adverse letter specifying alcohol-related information only, with the deadline left unfilled. No final rescission is documented. Signed forms and the letter use Brendan Ngwanforbi. Full map: PC29046_EVIDENCE.md.
procedural_status: Pre-filing. November 2, 2026 preliminary pre-adverse notice is in the file. No complaint, no final rescission, and no filled-in response date. Do not plead a completed denial. Source of the registry lines, and whether Hertz used them, remain open. See PC29046_EVIDENCE.md.
